original_publication.article: Gawecka et al. 2025 The Roles of Space and Food-Web Complexity in Mediating Ecological Recovery
original_publication.preexisting_main_effects: Authors already showed source number/position influences colonization of empty patches, foodweb complexity retards recovery. DO NOT claim them as new findings.

original_design.time: parse date dd/mm/yyyy and time H:M:S; actual elapsed since FIRST sample in same experimental landscape; no date interpolation

focal_question: In one-peripheral-source landscapes (1P), is positive Brevicoryne count ever first observed in a TWO-LINK peripheral patch before a positive sample is recorded in the obligatory ONE-LINK center stepping stone?

frozen_estimand.main_stratum: exactly landscape=1P, all 3 community classes and all 5 replication landscapes
frozen_estimand.primary_observation: For each independent 1P landscape: compare first observed positive of central patch1 (distance1) with earliest of peripheral empty patches3,4,5 (distance2), using actual timestamp ordering only
outcomes: center positive earlier than earliest distal positive
center and earliest distal positive same sampling timestamp
distal positive earlier than center first positive
distal positive but center never detected positive
center detected but distal never detected
frozen_estimand.secondary: For each 1P landscape first distance2 patch observed positivity vs first center observed positivity, signed time difference only if both detected; record patches-level first positivity and right censoring, no imputation of death or colonization
frozen_estimand.exploratory_all_layout_control: Report first-positive fraction by topology path distance over all 60 landscapes with all 150 initially empty patch series; do NOT infer causal distance effect comparing different layout treatments
frozen_estimand.missing_samples: NA or blank is missing, never zero. Detect interval only from an actually sampled previous zero to next positive. Ambiguous prior missing flag retained.
frozen_estimand.confidence: No p-values, no sampling-row or patch-level pseudo-independent CI. 15 landscapes are experimental clusters for main 1P.
